title: Revision reveals a principle’s substance

captions.physics: Examining a shared rule’s inadequate explanation

meaning: Revising an inadequate explanation can reveal an understood basis for a shared principle and bring a feeling of fresh possibilities within your view.
text: A familiar rule can retain meaning after a restrictive explanation breaks down. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly examining its inadequate foundations. The Hierophant in energy supports seeking an understood basis for shared meaning. The Empress in emotions feels a fresh view’s fruitfulness. Finding continuation where an earlier account failed can feel pleasing. Your question gains material for development connected with an understandable value within the principle.

For example, you associated attentive reading solely with a slow pace. Comparing a quickly read scene whose details remain memorable, you release that measure as sufficient. **Revision can restore a familiar principle’s living substance.** Wanting to understand its basis reveals attention’s connection with a question addressed to the text. Further discussion becomes possible. The observation can pleasingly enrich views of other books. A principle gains substance through a concrete scene while personal reading speeds and different reasons for remembering remain present for both people.

The risk is immediately deriving another universal rule from one fruitful example. Seeking an understood basis preserves the discovery’s boundary. A question made reading attentive in this instance. Your view can develop without premature generalisation while a sense of possibility sustains interest and the next text may reveal another way to notice what matters.
